{{Quote|Filli, inform whoever asked that question that I'm not about to go to guns with a Detainer CC-twenty-two hundred.|[[Jula Shryne]], to [[Filli Bitters]]|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
The '''Detainer CC-2200''' or '''Detainer CC-twenty-two-hundred''' was an type of [[Interdictor/Legends|Interdictor]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]].

==History==
{{Quote|I want Interdictor cruisers deployed to prevent any ships from jumping to hyperspace.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Detainers prevented ships from fleeing [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] several weeks after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, hundreds of trader ships were able to escape after the Detainer situated over [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] was destroyed by the kamikaze self-destruction of a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] reprogrammed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the crew of the ''[[Drunk Dancer]]''.
